QUOTE: "**Default build (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off, the shipped default):** `include/mbedtls/platform.h:166-167` defines `mbedtls_calloc` as `calloc` and `mbedtls_free` as `free`. The call is libc `calloc`, resolved at compile time. The `platform.c` hook code is compiled out."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that in the default build, mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are defined as calloc and free at compile time, with no hook code, which is no indirection.
